svg.title: kevfang03's sky islands

Level 2 with 117 contributions; 4 repositories stand as buildings: tdx-queue-auditor, scis-help-assistant, kevfang-portfolio, strategi-score. Now building tdx-queue-auditor, 6 commits from its next tier. Your baby dragon, Pip, waits on the HQ roof.
